title: Gold Import Duty Raised from 6% to 15%: Full Impact Explained
content:
On 10th May 2026, Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke directly to the people of India. In a simple and emotional appeal, he requested everyone to stop buying gold for weddings and functions for one year.

As we all know, the value of the dollar is increasing day by day. With global tensions rising and pressure on our foreign reserves, Prime Minister Modi appealed to citizens to put the nation’s needs before tradition and stop buying gold for one year. 

In a country that loves gold so much, this request has left everyone thinking. Will Indians listen? Let’s know each and everything regarding if we purchase gold or not.

What is Gold Import Duty?

Gold Import Duty is basically a tax that the Indian government collects when gold is imported from other countries. For example if you bring the gold from other countries you need to pay Import Duty in form of tex.Right now, it stands at 15%. The main aim is to control how much gold India buys from abroad, protect our foreign reserves, and discourage people from spending too much on gold.

Reasons Behind PM Modi’s Decision to Increase Gold Import Duty

Everyone is excited to know why PM increased the import duty on gold as it is loved by every Indian citizens. The main reasons are rising global tensions, a stronger dollar, and increasing pressure on India’s foreign reserves. By raising the duty to 15%, the government wants to reduce heavy gold imports, save precious foreign currency, and encourage people to think twice before buying more gold.

Impact of Increased Gold Import Duty on Common Indians in 2026

The increased gold import duty to 15% has started showing its impact in 2026. Common people are now paying higher prices for gold jewellery, making weddings and festivals more expensive. Gold shopkeepers are seeing fewer customers and slower sales. On the international front, reduced demand from India is putting slight pressure on global gold prices. Overall, the move is helping the government control imports but is pinching the pockets of ordinary Indians.

Final Thoughts: The Real Cost of Gold in Today’s India 

Gold is more than just jewellery, it's an emotion for every Indian. But in 2026, loving gold has become expensive for both families and the country. With higher import duty and the PM's appeal, it’s time to pause and think. Every extra gram costs more now. Saving dollars today can make India stronger tomorrow. Let’s celebrate wisely.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Q: Why was the gold import duty raised to 15%?
Indian Government increased the import duty on gold because the dollar value is increasing rapidly and to reduce the trade deficit, and stabilize the national currency, the government has taken this step.
Q: How does this impact jewelry prices?
The increase in gold import duty leads to the increase in retail gold prices, making jewelry more expensive for domestic consumers.
Q: Will this affect the jewelry industry?
Offcourse, the increase in the gold import duty affects the jewelry industry as it reduces the customers and the demand also gets reduced.
Q: What is the Gold Price Today?
The gold price is not the same everyday. Individuals can check the current gold price from its official websites.

title: Petrol Diesel Prices Rise Again: What Happens Next?
content:
Breaking news for all the citizens, once again facing a sharp rise in fuel prices as petrol and diesel rates increased for the second time within a week. In Delhi, petrol has now reached ₹98.64 per litre, while diesel climbed to ₹91.58 after consecutive price revisions by oil companies.

The recent fuel price hike is mainly due to rising crude oil prices in the global market, with Brent crude crossing $111 per barrel because of ongoing tensions in West Asia and lower supply of discounted Russian oil. People across the country are worried that expensive fuel could soon make transport, food, and other daily essentials costlier.

India Fuel Hike: Petrol & Diesel Up 90 Paise Again

India is facing another fuel price shock as petrol and diesel prices increased by 90 paise on Tuesday, just days after a massive ₹3 per litre hike. In Delhi, petrol prices have now reached ₹98.64 per litre. With global crude oil prices crossing $111 per barrel, the continuous rise has triggered strong public concern over inflation and higher daily expenses.

2nd Fuel Price Hike in 5 Days Hits India

Petrol and diesel prices were increased by 90 paise after an earlier ₹3 per litre jump last week. In Delhi, petrol has now touched ₹98.64 per litre, while rising global crude oil prices continue to fuel public concern over inflation and increasing living costs.

title: Why Parle Share Price Is Trending Today After PM Modi’s Viral Melody Moment
content:
Hello friends, here is the latest update for you all. As we all know, Prime Minister Narendra Modi ji recently went on a foreign trip where a viral moment with Italy’s PM Giorgia Meloni grabbed huge attention on social media. Reports say that PM Modi gifted the famous Melody toffee to Italy’s PM Giorgia Meloni during the meeting, and the clip soon went viral online.

After this viral video started trending on social media, many people began searching for Parle-related stocks, which suddenly pushed Parle Industries share price into the spotlight. Since morning, the stock has been trending heavily among retail investors and across business news platforms.

Why Parle Industries Share Price Suddenly Jumped After the Viral Melody Moment

Everyone is excited to know the reason behind the sudden increase in the Parle Industries share price. The main reason behind this rally is the viral moment when Prime Minister Narendra Modi gifted the famous Melody toffee to Italy’s PM Giorgia Meloni during his foreign visit. 

After the clip went viral on social media, many people started searching for Parle-related stocks and rushed to buy Parle Industries shares. However, the interesting fact is that Melody is actually made by Parle Products, which is a privately owned company and is not listed on the stock market. This confusion created a huge buzz among retail investors today.

How PM Modi and Giorgia Meloni’s Viral Video Triggered the Parle Stock Buzz

The viral video of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Italy’s PM Giorgia Meloni quickly became a hot topic on social media. Reports claimed that PM Modi gifted the famous Melody toffee during the meeting, and soon the clip started trending online. As people saw the word “Parle” linked with the viral moment, many investors began searching for Parle-related stocks. This sudden excitement created huge buzz in the market and pushed Parle Industries share price sharply higher in a short time. Interestingly, Melody is made by Parle Products, which is not a listed company, but the viral social media trend still boosted investor interest today.

Who Really Makes Melody Toffee? Here’s the Truth Behind the Parle Name

This is the big confusion among the people today. Many investors believe that Parle Industries is the company behind the famous Melody toffee, but that is not true. Melody is actually made by Parle Products, the well-known FMCG company famous for Parle-G biscuits, Mango Bite, KrackJack, and other popular snacks. 

However, Parle Products is a privately owned company and is not listed on the stock market. Meanwhile, Parle Industries is a separate listed company with no direct connection to Melody candies. The similar “Parle” name created confusion among retail investors after the viral PM Modi and Meloni moment.

Why Retail Investors Rushed to Buy Parle Shares After the Viral Clip

As PM Modi gifted the Melody toffee during his meeting with Italy’s PM Giorgia Meloni, the clip quickly became viral on social media. After seeing the trending video, many retail investors started searching for Parle-related stocks and rushed to buy Parle Industries shares. This sudden buzz increased buying activity in the stock market. However, many people later realised that Melody is actually made by Parle Products, which is not a listed company.

Parle Products and Parle Industries Are Different  Here’s Why the Confusion Happened

After the news came that PM Modi gifted Melody toffee to Giorgia Meloni, everyone started searching about Parle on social media and Google. But the real thing is that many people became confused between Parle Products and Parle Industries. 

Parle Products is the company that actually makes Melody, Parle-G, Mango Bite, and other famous snacks, but it is not listed on the stock market. Meanwhile, Parle Industries is a separate listed company with no direct connection to Melody candies. 

Due to the similar “Parle” name and the viral social media buzz, many retail investors rushed to buy Parle Industries shares, which increased the stock’s attention today.

Conclusion

This viral moment clearly shows how social media trends can quickly impact the stock market. Investors should avoid buying stocks only after seeing viral news or hype online. Before investing in any stock, always do proper research and understand the company details carefully.

title: iPhone 18 Leaks: Expected Launch Date, Features, Price & Design
content:
Breaking news for all the iPhone lovers, Apple is all set to launch the much-awaited iPhone 18 with exciting new features, a powerful processor, and a stylish new design. According to early leaks and reports, the upcoming iPhone could bring major upgrades in AI technology, camera quality, battery life, and performance. Apple fans across the world are already excited to see what the tech giant has planned for its next-generation smartphone.

I Phone 18 Launch Date

Apple is expected to launch the new iPhone 18 in June 2026, and fans are already waiting excitedly for the official announcement. While the company has not confirmed the exact date yet, several reports suggest that Apple may introduce the smartphone with advanced AI features, improved cameras, and a more powerful performance. The launch event is likely to attract huge attention from tech lovers around the world.

Apple IPhone 18 Price

The expected price of the iPhone 18 in India could be around ₹1,34,900 for the premium variant. According to early reports, Apple may slightly increase the pricing due to major AI upgrades, a powerful chipset, and a premium body design. In the global market, the iPhone 18 Pro is expected to start near $1,149 (around ₹1.06 lakh), while the Pro Max version could be priced at nearly $1,249 (around ₹1.15 lakh).

iPhone 18 New Features & Body Design

The iPhone 18 is expected to come with a premium new look and smarter AI-powered features for a better user experience. Apple may also introduce a slimmer body design with improved display quality and stronger performance.

  • iPhone 18 New Features & Body Design

  • Advanced AI-powered features

  • New slim and lightweight body design

  • Improved camera quality with better zoom

  • Faster A20 Bionic chipset performance

  • Bigger battery backup and fast charging

  • Nearly bezel-less display with smoother refresh rate

  • Strong titanium frame for premium feel

  • Better Face ID and security features

  • Enhanced gaming and multitasking experience

  • New stylish color options expected

iPhone 18 vs iPhone 18 Pro vs iPhone 18 Pro Max Comparison

The standard iPhone 18 is expected to be perfect for regular users who want a stylish phone with smooth performance, a good camera, and strong battery life at a comparatively lower price. It may come with a compact design and smart AI features for daily use.

The iPhone 18 Pro could offer a more premium experience with a titanium body, advanced camera system, and faster A20 Pro chipset. This model may be ideal for creators, multitaskers, and users who want extra power and professional-level features.

Meanwhile, the iPhone 18 Pro Max is likely to become the most powerful model in the lineup. It may feature the biggest display, best battery backup, improved zoom camera, and top-level gaming performance. Apple could also introduce exclusive AI tools and premium upgrades in this high-end variant.

While the iPhone 18 may focus on affordability and balanced performance, the Pro and Pro Max versions are expected to deliver a more luxurious and feature-packed experience for heavy users and tech lovers.

Who Should Buy the iPhone 18 Series?

The iPhone 18 series could be a great choice for users looking for premium design, powerful performance, and advanced AI features. The standard iPhone 18 may suit everyday users, while the Pro and Pro Max models could be perfect for gamers, content creators, photographers, and people who want the best Apple experience.
